title: August and the Wolf
author: I. M. Thackeray
blurb: Casper Blackwood, a thief who steals memories, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
